note: Audrain County publishes no zoning districts layer. Zoning is handled by the City of Mexico (county seat), whose Skyview GIS and Zoning Map pages were not reachable and no queryable zoning service was found; the county GIS offers only parcel research (integritygis viewer). Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the Missouri state GIS (gis.mo.gov) found no Audrain or Mexico zoning service; the one Zoning_Districts layer that turned up has no features in the county.
